steps.code:
# Process each markdown file: read content, derive title, create note
import os

for file_path in files:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Derive title: filename without extension, replace underscores with spaces
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)  # e.g., "Book_Reading_Lists.md"
    title = filename[:-3]  # remove ".md"
    title = title.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note in Simple Note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        title=title,
        content=content,
        access_token=sn_token
    )
    print(f"Created note for {filename}: {result}")
